王野催促道：“徐队长，你还是赶紧去跟列车长汇报一下吧，这火车马上就要发车了。”

徐亮一听这话点着头就跑向了车头，没一会儿就又跑回来了。回来后只跟王野打了个招呼就又小跑着进了车厢，接着车厢里就传出了阵阵哀嚎。听的王野后背都起鸡皮疙瘩了。

过了没有二十分钟徐亮就兴高采烈的从包厢出来了，一路哈哈大笑的走到王野身边：“兄弟，你就是我亲兄弟呀，这次你分给徐哥的这份功劳真大呀。”

王野心想：“这个徐亮也真是不要脸，两波人才刚发生冲突，现在就徐哥了就是亲兄弟了”。

徐亮继续说道：“兄弟，这次咱们真是摸到大鱼了，这个小子叫冯南华，后面有一个小队的特务，这次就是要摸清咱们这趟车的底细，实施破坏行动。”

王野纳闷道：“破坏，破坏什么呀，一车钢材怎么破坏呀？”

徐亮：“他们破坏的是咱们的民心，具体能不能成功，造成的损失多大他们不在乎。”

王野恍然大悟，这不就是后世的恐怖分子吗，这帮人就是要制造混乱，具体混乱给他得到多少好处不重要。王野问道：“徐队长，那接下来怎么处理呀，不会是要留下来破了案再走吧？”

徐队长嘿嘿一笑：“不用，直接移交本地公安局就好了。咱们已经拿到了铁证，又拿到了口供，这份功劳咱们已经是最大头的了，还是要给本地公安局留点汤汤水水的。”

王野这时想到了一句话：“三人行必有我师。”这个徐队长乍一看没什么头脑，可是从他处理这个冯南华来看，这人也不简单，就连在车上和孙叔起冲突应该也是有目的的。

过了一会儿就有一队公安来到火车最后这节车厢，徐队长赶紧上前进行交流。王野并没有上前，而是开启了精神力开始偷听。

徐队长上前对着对方领头的敬了一个礼说道：“彭所长好。”

彭所长欣慰的拍了拍徐队长的肩膀说：“小徐厉害呀，就停车这么会儿功夫就抓了条这么大的鱼。”

徐队长解释道：“这也是运气，还多亏了王野同志，这次轧钢厂保卫科的同志才是头功，我们就是跟着沾点光。”

彭所长哦了一声问道：“那这个王野同志呢？”

徐亮转身对着王野招手，王野其实不想掺和进去的。可是徐亮都招呼了不去实在不合适，只能微微摇头叹了口气走了过去。

王野上前徐亮热情的拉住王野的手对着彭所长介绍道：“彭所长，这就是王野同志，王野这位是本地的派出所所长。”

王野硬着头皮上去打了个招呼，彭所长热情的说：“小王同志年轻有为呀，小小年纪就可以勇于上前，心思缜密。”

人家都把恭维话怼脸上了，王野只好客气了两句。三人又互相商业吹捧了几句就开始了交接工作。其实交接很简单，人带走，口供拿走，徐亮还给了一份抓捕审问过程的报告。

就这样很快就结束交接，火车也顺利出发了。这次出发，徐亮四人对王野他们的态度好了太多了，那真是不笑不说话。各种恭维的话不要钱的说个没完。

王野实在受不了这个，就躲在包厢里看书不出来了。时间很快就过去，两天后的下午终于到了目的地，王野和众人开始忙活起来，最主要是两位调度员，王野他们主要是继续巡逻，防止意外发生。

Wang Ye urged: "Captain Xu, you should hurry up and report to the conductor. The train is about to leave."

When Xu Liang heard this, he nodded and ran to the front of the car, and ran back after a while.After coming back, he just said hello to Wang Ye and trotted into the carriage again, and then bursts of wailing could be heard in the carriage.Wang Ye got goosebumps on his back after hearing this.

Less than twenty minutes later, Xu Liang came out of the box happily and walked to Wang Ye laughing all the way: "Brother, you are my brother. The credit you gave to Brother Xu this time is really great."

Wang Ye thought: "This Xu Liang is really shameless. The two waves of people just clashed, and now Brother Xu is our brother."

Xu Liang continued: "Brother, we really caught a big fish this time. This guy's name is Feng Nanhua, and there is a team of agents behind him. This time he wants to find out the details of our train and carry out sabotage operations."

Wang Ye wondered: "Destruction, what is it destroying? How can a load of steel be destroyed?"

Xu Liang: "What they are destroying is our people's hearts. They don't care whether they can succeed or how much damage they cause."

Wang Ye suddenly realized, aren't these the terrorists of later generations? These people just want to create chaos, and it doesn't matter how much benefit he gets from the chaos.Wang Ye asked: "Captain Xu, what are you going to do next? Are you going to stay and solve the case before leaving?"

Captain Xu chuckled: "No, just hand it over to the local Public Security Bureau. We have obtained the irrefutable evidence and the confession. We already deserve the most credit for this, but we still have to leave some to the local Public Security Bureau."

At this time, Wang Ye thought of a sentence: "If there are three people in the company, there must be one of my masters." Captain Xu seemed to have no brains at first glance, but judging from his handling of Feng Nanhua, this person was not simple. Even the conflict with Uncle Sun in the car should have a purpose.

After a while, a team of police officers came to the last carriage of the train, and Captain Xu quickly stepped forward to communicate.Wang Ye did not step forward, but activated his mental power and began to eavesdrop.

Captain Xu stepped forward and saluted the leader and said, "Hello, Director Peng."

Director Peng patted Captain Xu on the shoulder happily and said, "Xiao Xu is amazing. He just stopped the car for a short time and caught such a big fish."

Captain Xu explained: "This is also luck, and thanks to Comrade Wang Ye, the comrades from the security department of the steel rolling mill are the first to take the lead this time, and we are just going to get some credit."

Director Peng snorted and asked, "What about Comrade Wang Ye?"

Xu Liang turned around and waved to Wang Ye, but Wang Ye actually didn't want to get involved.But Xu Liang didn't even say hello. It was inappropriate to go, so he could only shake his head slightly and sigh and walked over.

Wang Ye stepped forward. Xu Liang enthusiastically took Wang Ye's hand and introduced Director Peng: "Director Peng, this is Comrade Wang Ye. Wang Ye is the director of the local police station."

Wang Ye bravely went up to say hello, and Director Peng said enthusiastically: "Comrade Xiao Wang is young and promising. At a young age, he can step forward bravely and be thoughtful."

Everyone had their compliments thrown back in their faces, so Wang Ye could only say a few polite words.The three of them exchanged some business compliments and then started the handover work.In fact, the handover was very simple. The person was taken away, the confession was taken away, and Xu Liang also gave a report on the arrest and interrogation process.

The handover was quickly completed and the train set off smoothly.This time, the attitude of Xu Liang and the others towards Wang Ye and the others was much better. They really didn't laugh or talk.All kinds of free compliments can be said endlessly.

Wang Ye really couldn't bear this, so he hid in the box and read a book.Time passed quickly, and they finally arrived at their destination in the afternoon two days later. Wang Ye and everyone began to get busy, the most important of which were the two dispatchers. Wang Ye and the others mainly continued patrolling to prevent accidents.
